text: The humpback whale is known for its long songs and for breaching high out of the water.
Sperm whales are the largest toothed predators and can dive for more than an hour.
The African elephant is the largest living land animal, with adults weighing several tonnes.
Whale sharks are the largest fish in the ocean and feed mainly on plankton.
Dinosaurs such as Argentinosaurus were among the largest animals ever to walk on land.
Orcas are the largest members of the dolphin family and hunt in cooperative groups.
Gray whales migrate along the Pacific coast between feeding grounds and warm breeding lagoons.
The Mona Lisa is displayed behind protective glass and draws millions of visitors each year.
A famous portrait of a woman with a faint smile is among the most visited artworks in Paris.
The Louvre was a royal palace before it became a public museum in the late eighteenth century.
The Last Supper is a mural painted on the wall of a refectory in Milan.
Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel in the early sixteenth century.
Renaissance portraits often used thin oil glazes to create soft transitions between light and shadow.
The Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre in the early twentieth century and later recovered.
The Berlin Wall was first built in 1961 to stop movement between East and West Berlin.
Checkpoint Charlie was one of the best known crossing points between East and West Berlin.
The Brandenburg Gate in Berlin became a symbol of German division and later of reunification.
East Germany was officially known as the German Democratic Republic.
The Soviet Union was dissolved at the end of the Cold War, ending decades of rivalry with the United States.
Sections of the Berlin Wall are now preserved as memorials and open-air galleries in Berlin.
The Cold War was a long period of political tension between the United States and the Soviet Union.
Anthropic is an artificial intelligence company that develops the Claude family of language models.
Release notes for a language model usually list the version number, the new capabilities and the availability date.
Claude models are available through a web app, an API and several cloud platforms.
Model names often combine a family name such as Sonnet with a version number.
Benchmarks for coding assistants include tasks such as fixing bugs and writing unit tests.
Language model providers sometimes publish a model card describing intended uses and limitations.
Newer versions of a language model usually improve on reasoning, coding and long-context tasks.
The US Open is played on hard courts at the National Tennis Center in Queens, New York.
The men's singles draw at a Grand Slam tournament has 128 players.
Arthur Ashe Stadium is the largest tennis stadium in the world by seating capacity.
Grand Slam men's singles matches are played as best of five sets.
In 2022, the four Grand Slam tournaments adopted the same ten-point tiebreak at six games all in the final set.
The other three Grand Slam tournaments are the Australian Open, the French Open and Wimbledon.
Tennis rankings are updated weekly based on results from the previous fifty-two weeks.
AI safety research studies how to make advanced AI systems reliable, controllable and aligned with human values.
Public statements about AI risk often prompt long threads of replies and responses on social media.
Researchers disagree about how likely it is that advanced AI could cause large-scale harm within a few decades.
Some AI companies employ interpretability researchers who study what happens inside neural networks.
Surveys of machine learning researchers have asked for estimates of long-term risks from advanced AI.
A researcher who leaves an AI company often explains the decision in a public post.
The Siberian cat has a thick triple coat and is often described as one of the more allergy-friendly breeds.
Ragdoll cats are known for going limp when picked up and for their calm, friendly nature.
Domestic cats usually reach adulthood at around one year old and can live for more than fifteen years.
Siamese cats are vocal and form strong bonds with their owners.
The Persian cat has a long coat that needs brushing every day.
In a home with two cats, an older cat and a younger cat often settle into separate favorite spots.
Veterinarians recommend yearly checkups for adult cats and more frequent visits for senior cats.
Breath of the Wild was released in 2017, and Tears of the Kingdom followed six years later.
Many players spend well over a hundred hours exploring open-world Zelda games.
Ocarina of Time, released in 1998, is often ranked among the greatest video games ever made.
The hero of the Legend of Zelda series is Link, a young adventurer who rarely speaks.
Nintendo consoles record play time for each game, which players can check in their profile.
Speedrunners compete to finish Zelda games in the shortest possible time.
The National Novel Writing Month challenge asked participants to write fifty thousand words in thirty days.
Epic fantasy novels often run well beyond one hundred and fifty thousand words.
Writers often track word counts to measure daily progress on a long story.
A short story is usually under seven thousand five hundred words long.
Many first drafts of long stories are cut substantially during revision.
Writing in a cafe is a popular habit among authors who find home too distracting.
Photosynthesis converts sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into sugars and oxygen.
The Amazon River carries more water to the ocean than any other river.
Bread dough rises because yeast produces carbon dioxide as it ferments sugars.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.
The human heart pumps blood through two circuits, one to the lungs and one to the rest of the body.
A haiku is a short Japanese poem with three lines.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceans.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Copper conducts electricity well and is widely used in wiring.
Rainbows appear when sunlight is refracted and reflected inside water droplets.
The printing press made books cheaper and helped spread literacy across Europe.
Honey bees communicate the location of flowers through a waggle dance.
The metric system is based on units of ten.
Volcanoes form where molten rock reaches the surface of the Earth.
A balanced diet includes vegetables, fruit, whole grains and protein.
The violin is a string instrument played with a bow.
Glaciers are large masses of ice that move slowly under their own weight.
The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
Soccer is played by two teams of eleven players.
Coral reefs support a large share of marine species despite covering a small area of the ocean.
Electric cars store energy in large rechargeable batteries.
The Nile flows north through Egypt toward the Mediterranean Sea.
Tea is made by steeping the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant in hot water.
Sound travels faster through water than through air.
Libraries lend books and provide quiet spaces for study.
The moon's gravity causes the tides in Earth's oceans.
Origami is the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes.
Vaccines train the immune system to recognize a disease without causing it.
A leap year has an extra day added to February.
Wind turbines turn the motion of air into electricity.
Chess is a strategy game played on a board of sixty-four squares.
Granite is a hard igneous rock made mostly of quartz and feldspar.
Monsoons bring heavy seasonal rains to parts of South Asia.
A standard piano has eighty-eight keys.
Maple syrup is made by boiling down the sap of maple trees.
Satellites orbit the Earth and are used for communication and weather forecasting.
The Great Wall of China was built over many centuries to protect the northern borders.
Marathon runners cover a distance of just over forty-two kilometers.
Penguins are flightless birds that live mostly in the Southern Hemisphere.
Sourdough bread relies on a fermented mixture of flour and water called a starter.
